methodology.fresh_healthy_solver: Same healthy23model/28 original markers, OpenSim Python API and native tool flags as rebuilt preparation, no ScaleTool/remap/calibration/ID/RRA/dynamics.
methodology.functional_point: Ankle parent joint socket origin, not sole/marker; same healthy model for original-to-fresh solution comparison.
methodology.geometry_grid_filter: Recorded full-trial zero-phase6Hz/order4/resample1ms; saved primary native1ms grid plus exact frozen HS/TO/nextHS; same3 cycles/percycle/20 stance bins as frozen geometry helper.
methodology.cache_reuse: Original healthy and production-prepared FK summaries reused with all cached source hashes verified; common rebuilt JointSet semantically exact and full IK byte-identical.
methodology.interpretation: Difference of IK solutions under observed markers/tool contract; healthy B-A combines subject anatomy/gait/marker/acquisition and solver conventions. No anatomy causal share, hardware-ground validation or dynamic causal conclusion.
